metricDefinitions.publicDebt: Latest government debt, % GDP; perimeters differ

US.summary: Origin of the shock. Funding-market depth decides whether an equity reset becomes a banking crisis.

China.summary: Little direct AI exposure, but property and LGFV balance sheets make it the second fault line.
China.shockRole: Property-debt amplifier and potential Treasury seller

EU.summary: Mostly conventional industry with little direct AI exposure and no property-debt loop. Trade, bank and dollar-funding links carry the first-round hit.
EU.shockRole: Cushioned loser; conditional safe-asset and geopolitical gainer

Switzerland.summary: Low debt and safe-haven demand cushion funding stress; a stronger franc hurts exports.
Switzerland.shockRole: Safe haven with an export cost
